chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم entered into ihram in two garments of cotton.
ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم wear when entering ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم entered the state of ihram wearing two cotton garments. It indicates a Prophetic practice connected to the rites and attire of hajj.
